nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set once at construction time and used by onlyOwner access control.
Reference to the NoahToken interface used for balance queries and token transfers.
Ownable() constructor that assigns ownership of the deployed contract.
onlyOwner modifier guarding privileged functions by comparing caller against owner.
NoahDividend(address) constructor that stores the NoahToken contract address.
Public view function returning the NoahToken balance of a given investor.
Owner-only batch transfer distributing token amounts to a list of investors.
msg.sender read inside the Ownable constructor; external caller controlled value.
msg.sender read inside the onlyOwner modifier; external caller controlled value.
Assignment owner = msg.sender; the only access-control gate for all privileged functions.
Comparison msg.sender != owner followed by revert() that enforces the owner restriction.
External call noahToken.transfer(investors[i], tokenAmounts[i]) executed in a loop before results are finalized.
Constructor parameter supplying the NoahToken contract address.
Investor address whose NoahToken balance is queried.
Array of recipient addresses for the batch transfer.
Array of token amounts matched positionally with the investors array.
Return array of addresses that were successfully transferred to.
Loop index over the investors/tokenAmounts arrays and array index for the external transfer call.
Boolean flag holding the return value of noahToken.transfer.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor reads the untrusted msg.sender to determine initial ownership.
Untrusted msg.sender flows directly into the ownership assignment.
Constructor body executes the owner = msg.sender operation.
Unsafe ownership assignment writes the privileged owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier reads the untrusted msg.sender for the authorization check.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside the guard before revert().
owner state variable is read by the modifier authorization check.
The revert() guard aborts execution of the guarded function body when the caller is not the owner.
onlyOwner modifier wraps the privileged multiTransfer function.
Constructor parameter noahTokenAddress is consumed by the NoahDividend constructor.
Constructor forwards the supplied address parameter into the token interface cast.
Constructor assigns the created interface instance to the noahToken state variable.
Caller-supplied investor address is used in the balance query.
balanceOfInvestor invokes noahToken.balanceOf on the stored token contract.
investors array parameter drives the multiTransfer loop and results array length.
tokenAmounts array parameter drives the multiTransfer loop and length validation.
multiTransfer allocates and returns the results array of successfully paid addresses.
multiTransfer loop initializes and increments the index variable i.
Loop index i indexes both arrays passed to the external transfer call.
investors[i] recipient address is passed to the external token transfer.
tokenAmounts[i] amount is passed to the external token transfer.
noahToken state variable is the target contract of the external transfer call.
multiTransfer performs an external token transfer inside the loop before results are fully written, allowing reentrant calls.
Return value of noahToken.transfer is captured into the result local variable.
Successful transfer flag gates writing the investor address into results[i].
Recipient address from the investors array is stored into the results array.
The external noahToken.transfer call can re-enter multiTransfer (or other owner-only logic) through a malicious token contract.
Loop index i controls iteration and loop termination in multiTransfer.
multiTransfer body evaluates the boolean result of each transfer to decide on results[i].

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter exists only to initialize the noahToken state variable inside the constructor.
The investor parameter is used solely as the lookup argument of the single balance query.
The investors array parameter is the primary input consumed exclusively by the multiTransfer loop.
The tokenAmounts array parameter is consumed exclusively by the multiTransfer loop and length check.
results is the return buffer of multiTransfer and has no meaning outside that function.
Loop index i exists only to index the arrays supplied to the external token transfer call.
result only holds the boolean returned by the external noahToken.transfer call.
